title: Research: price a zero-retention QQ16 decoder at a two-chart frame
body:
PR2540 explicitly asks for a comparison against a decoder that reads the complete current state and retains no early records. This supplies one such finite word, returning the same 224 original arrays in F_U1 while leaving all 224 borrowed current fields untouched. It uses both chart queries in a common 25-axis frame and at most sixteen local scratch arrays.

The result is a **constructive storage/cost comparison**, with a stopping decision for this specific recipe:

| Added local charge | PR2540 pinned word | This word |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Early banks / owned values retained across B1 | 16 / 16 | 0 / 0 |
| Rank-one / rank-eight children | 224 / 16 | 112 / 448 |
| Native rank mass | 352 | 3696 |
| Native monomial wrappers | 480 | 1120 |
| Full-cover maps | 208 | 464 |
| Real scalar primitive allowance | 17472 | 25840 |
| Owned final output banks / peak local scratch | 224 / 16 | 224 / 16 |

At the same parent width and `0<=a<=1`, its child-moment difference has numerator `432*8^(1-a)-112 >= 320`. This common-frame recipe increases the local recursive bill. It does not rule out cheaper direct-current decoders or establish a complete physical-cost comparison.

Only `research/qq16-zero-retention-comparison/` is added: ordered proof, 4047-record literal word, deterministic exact receipt, source pins, task/family decision and opt-in replay. Full-current invertibility was already known; the new artifact is the concrete same-endpoint realization and its complete added local invoice. F0/B1 retain their inherited costs. Physical allocation, movement, child/wrapper hosting, precision, output consumption and complete supplier admission remain open. No selected frontier or new kappa claim.

Validation on Windows, standard-library **CPython 3.12.14**:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-zero-retention-comparison
```

The registered optimized primary and all four integrity groups pass. Coverage includes both inverse orders on 224 free input symbols, 286376 routed operator terms, 112 noncommuting chart pairs, complete frame-polynomial identities and 605248 independently evaluated characters, 57344 rank-one basis columns, 256 rank-eight kernel coefficients, twelve semantic failure controls, a Git-free read-only export, source-byte corruption, a bool/int receipt mutation and overwrite refusal. Metadata/source-pin validation and `git diff --check` also pass. No hosted CI, full supplier replay, proof assistant or independent human/subagent review is claimed.

Started from freshly fetched canonical main `b4560d9e7216f72b73c5aa940ac099c05e33ccf9`, priority revision 5, and rebased onto `1884c509efc004524786e9b7cfcc4aca572316d5`. Guidance, selected record and scientific inputs are unchanged by the new review. Final overlap covered **829 open PRs including drafts and 1311 Discussion records with complete pagination**, fetched at 16:58/17:00 UTC; scoped remote matches were the advance claim and credited PR2511. Coverage excludes arbitrary diffs/nested files and is not a novelty proof. [Canonical claim/result: Discussion2650](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2650). Discussion2617's pending early-output coalescing is complementary and still retains sixteen values across B1.

Credit **Ali Romman and the QQ16 team** for the maps and ordered inverse, **ywz65/PR2540** at `630d557af5088f66b45c447969cee9576600e50b` and PR2511 for the comparison request, and the retained starship-s/PR2443, thakrarsagar/PR2470, Ross Richardson/PR2480 and PR2456/2468/2492/2512 native/source-binding lineage. New word, proof, comparison and checker by **Arham Tahir with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance**. Apache-2.0; source notes and attribution retained.
